verdict.rationale: The vendor docs cover relay fan-out, custom tracks, client libraries, and ffmpeg/OBS/GStreamer integrations, but nothing describes a path from a live session into a speech-to-text, model, and text-to-speech voice-agent pipeline. SageOx's community report shows a third party built its own transcription subscriber. That is a user-side build, not vendor documentation, and it covers only speech-to-text, not a model or text-to-speech.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech
